response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_all FROM c), k AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, c.cnt - a.avg_all AS above_avg FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_all), k2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_kept FROM k) SELECT k.account_id, k.cnt AS order_count, k.above_avg AS diff_from_avg, k.cnt - k2.avg_kept AS diff_from_kept_avg FROM k, k2 ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Averages are computed as exact (non-rounded) floating-point values; AVG over integer counts returns a real in SQLite. Ties in the sort are broken arbitrarily.
